Cover.value:
1. Fill in the blue cells across the Cargo, Vessel, Fuel, Port, and Regulation tabs — each covers one area of the model, mirroring how this will eventually work as a web form.
2. The 'Calculation' tab builds the year-by-year cost and discounts it automatically — no need to edit it.
3. Read the results on the 'Output' tab.
Blue text = input cell (edit these). Black text = formula (do not overwrite).

Regulation.value: Applied on top of the corridor costs. Each module can be switched off independently. Figures reflect known 2026 rules/market levels — always confirm current values before relying on results.

Calculation.value: This sheet builds automatically from the Cargo/Vessel/Fuel/Port/Regulation tabs. No need to edit anything here.
Green = year used in the model, red = beyond the modelled horizon.
